data.one_liner: Custom elevated button with gradient background for Flutter apps
data.what_it_does: Provides a GradientElevatedButton widget that supports gradient backgrounds, custom foreground colors, padding, shape, elevation, and theming via ThemeExtension. It works with both Flutter's material and the standalone material_ui package.
use_when: You need a button with a gradient background
You want to theme all gradient buttons consistently across the app
You are using material_ui or Flutter 3.47+
avoid_when: You are targeting Flutter versions below 3.27 and cannot use material_ui
You need a button that supports complex animations beyond simple gradients
strengths: Easy to use API with styleFrom
Works with both material and material_ui
Includes widget tests and migration guide
weaknesses: Not compatible with older Flutter versions
Limited to elevated button style only
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec, import package, use GradientElevatedButton widget
